schema.description: Config file schema version. Only ever read/written by the same local CLI installation, so no cross-version tolerance is needed here.

secrets.description: Optional: absent entirely until the user first configures secrets.

defaultProvider.description: Provider instance name used for a mapping that omits its own "provider".

providers.description: Provider instances by instance name. Exactly the two v1 provider types (D6) — widening this union is a schema change for a later version.

account.description: 1Password account shorthand, URL, or ID (also settable via OP_ACCOUNT).

timeoutMs.description: Per-invocation timeout for the op CLI.

mappings.description: Logical secret name -> provider reference. Names use the same pattern as manifest.json's requires.secrets.

reference.description: Opaque provider-specific reference. Control characters, newlines, and null bytes are rejected as a defense-in-depth baseline; provider-specific format rules (e.g. op:// prefix) are enforced by the provider module, not here.
